text: Summarize the following design for a systems engineer: a bare-metal MoE runtime that pages 256-expert layers (top-8) from NVMe through a DMA staging ring into fused dequant+NEON kernels, with exact-priority I/O, L+1 early-router prefetch, FETCH/ADMIT split, and per-token telemetry (compute/unhidden_io/predictor/lm_head/other). Cover what is measured vs assumed, failure modes, and open questions. Target 600+ words of summary from the long brief embedded below. [Embed full InferNEON v1 brief sections 1-8 here at run time; record prompt hash.]

You are given three paper sketches: EdgeMoE (2-layer co-occurrence dictionary + pinned hot weights + expert buffer + lower precision), pre-gated MoE (trained next-layer gate), TinyLFU (admission filter with halving reset). Summarize each in 200+ words, then synthesize: what must a novelty argument address against each, and what single rerun (2-layer lookback) makes the comparison faithful? Total 700+ words.

Summarize a 4000-token technical discussion about PCIe Gen2 x1 ceilings, tile sizing 64KiB-1.5MiB, device queue 32, fused vs materialized dequant, and telemetry schema into: (1) 10-bullet executive summary, (2) table of ASSUMED parameters with defaults, (3) list of measurements that would flip conclusions under sensitivity sweep B={400,45,21} MB/s and GOPS={5,10,20}. [Long discussion pasted at run time; record hash.]

Summarize LLM-in-Flash for an OS dev: which tricks depend on ReLU sparsity in dense models (and do NOT transfer to SwiGLU Qwen), which one does transfer (co-locating rows+columns for one contiguous flash read), and how that maps to extent clustering on flash. 600+ words, no paper prose, factual only.

A held-out stream switches code to chat to math to Tamil to summarization with marked switch points and carried KV/cache state. Summarize what to report: windowed hit rate over time, recovery time to within 2 points of steady state, overall bytes/token, and whether any decay/admission variant beats lifetime LFU under shift. Explain why carrying state matters. 600+ words.

Summarize the MTP correction and output-head correction for this project: MTP predicts n+2 from end of n+1 pass (no mid-token early guess for n+1, at best prefetch n+2 during n+1), and the 509M head costs ~1GB BF16 / 250MB INT4 RAM read per token. State operational consequences: quarantine next-token branch, quantize head, measure CM4 RAM bandwidth before tok/s claims. 600+ words.

Condense the five-subsystem architecture (execution engine, expert scheduler, memory manager, streaming engine, telemetry/controller) into responsibilities, interfaces, and what each must NOT touch. Include the frozen v1 data path: exact router to residency to deadline queue to NVMe to staging to fused kernels to retain/discard, plus L+1 post-mix to lower-priority staging-only queue. Flag missing cancellation/backpressure paths. 700+ words.
